flow.name: patient-prc-api-main
flow.doc:description: Receives /api/* requests, validates them against the RAML and routes them to an operation flow

http:listener.doc:name: Listener /api/*
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts registration requests; every response carries X-Correlation-ID

flow-ref.name: start-request-context
flow-ref.doc:name: Start request context
flow-ref.doc:description: Captures the correlation ID and start time and logs the incoming request

apikit:router.doc:name: APIkit router
apikit:router.doc:description: Rejects requests that do not match the spec (400) and dispatches the rest

flow-ref.name: log-response-sent
flow-ref.doc:name: Log response sent
flow-ref.doc:description: Logs the response status and request duration

flow.name: post:\patients:application\json:patient-prc-api-config
flow.doc:name: POST /patients
flow.doc:description: Registers a patient: business rules, normalisation, store via the System API

flow-ref.name: register-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: Register patient
flow-ref.doc:description: Applies the business rules and stores the normalised record

set-variable.doc:name: Location header
set-variable.doc:description: Points the Location header at the new patient resource

flow.name: get:\patients\(patientId):patient-prc-api-config
flow.doc:name: GET /patients/{patientId}
flow.doc:description: Reads one patient through the System API in portal field names

set-variable.doc:name: Patient ID
set-variable.doc:description: Reads the patient ID from the URI

flow-ref.name: get-patient-record
flow-ref.doc:name: Get patient record
flow-ref.doc:description: Reads the record from the System API, retrying transient failures

ee:transform.doc:name: Record to patient
ee:transform.doc:description: Maps the System API record back to portal field names

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toPatient from dwl::PatientMapping output application/json --- toPatient(payload)

sub-flow.name: register-patient
sub-flow.doc:description: Business rules (422), mapping to the record format, store, map back

set-variable.doc:name: Clinic date today
set-variable.doc:description: Calendar date in the clinic time zone used by the rules and the category

choice.doc:name: Business rules
choice.doc:description: Rejects registrations that break a business rule, before calling the System API

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_BIRTH_DATE
raise-error.doc:description: Signals a future date of birth (422)

ee:transform.doc:name: Registration to record
ee:transform.doc:description: Normalises names, email and phone, maps gender, calculates the category

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toRecord from dwl::PatientMapping output application/json --- toRecord(payload, vars.today)

flow-ref.name: create-patient-record
flow-ref.doc:name: Create patient record
flow-ref.doc:description: Stores the record through the System API (never retried)

ee:transform.doc:name: Record to patient
ee:transform.doc:description: Maps the stored System API record back to portal field names

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toPatient from dwl::PatientMapping output application/json --- toPatient(payload)
